{{Quote|I promised Commander Graul he could execute you personally&mdash;and I left him a few gifts to help.|Sadic, to the Jedi Knight|<ref name="Red Light" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]]'s [[Desolator crisis|personal war]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] amid the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a '''skirmish''' occurred in the [[Power Guard Cybernetics Lab]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Sadic]], who had seized control of the [[Soldier/Legends|supersoldier]]-producing [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guard Project]], learned that a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] was [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Desolator crisis)|searching]] for the project, so he relocated the program to another location&mdash;but left a small group of [[Imperial soldier]]s under [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Graul (Human)|Graul]] to guard the facility, along with several [[Mark I Power Guard]]s. The [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and Power Guards were ultimately no match for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], who recovered Graul's [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] after the fight and used it to track down the project.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|When my men failed to report from the Nikto Sector, I knew it had to be your doing.|Sadic, to the Knight|<ref name="Red Light" />}}
In [[3643 BBY]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] declared a [[Desolator crisis|personal war]] against the Republic after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]]. Using stolen information on the [[Republic superweapon initiative]], Angral dispatched his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentices]] to seize control of several Republic [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] programs. Angral's apprentice, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Sadic]], was sent to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where the Republic had been developing the [[Power Guard Enhancement System]]&mdash;a program of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] enhancements and [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenal]] stimulants that produced [[Soldier/Legends|supersoldiers]]. After [[Attack on the Power Guard recruitment center|capturing]] the [[Power Guard recruitment center]], Sadic learned of the main [[Power Guard Cybernetics Lab]]'s location in Nar Shaddaa's [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]], and his forces quickly took control of the facility.<ref name="Red Light" />

However, when Sadic learned of a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight's]] arrival at the recruitment center and that the Knight was [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Desolator crisis)|searching]] for the cybernetics lab, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ordered his forces to take the project data and equipment to his [[Sadic's laboratory|lab]] in the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] district of [[Shadow Town]]. Sadic left [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Graul (Human)|Graul]] and several [[Mark I Power Guard]]s to guard the facility, as Graul wanted revenge on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] for the deaths of the Imperials who had been guarding the recruitment center. With the help of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the Republic's intelligence agency, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and a companion tracked down the lab by damaging power conduits throughout the Red Light Sector in order to determine which building had a separate power source.<ref name="Red Light" />

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|Mark One Power Guards. Not as destructive as the later models I possess, but quick to assemble and quite malleable. It took nothing to wipe their useless minds and program them to serve me.|Sadic|<ref name="Red Light" />}}
Entering the lab, the Knight and a companion dispatched the guards and the two [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] within the facility. When the duo reached Graul in the main chamber, they were greeted by a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of Sadic, who applauded the Knight's efforts. Anxious to avenge his men's deaths, Graul activated the three Mark I Power Guards that were still in the lab, and Sadic ended the communication as battle was joined. Though the Power Guards were equipped with advanced [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and weapons, Graul and the Power Guards were unable to defeat the Knight and the Jedi's companion, who killed the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] and dispatched the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]-like supersoldiers.<ref name="Red Light" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We're too late, Rieekan. Darth Angral's apprentice raided the lab. There's nothing left here. I found an encrypted datapad on an Imperial officer. Looks important.|The Knight|<ref name="Red Light" />}}
After the fighting ended, the Knight searched Graul's body and discovered an encrypted [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], though the rest of the facility yielded no clues as to Sadic's location. The Knight reported the find to SIS [[Bureau Chief|Chief]] [[Rieekan (SIS)|Rieekan]], who told the Jedi to bring it back to the [[SIS safe house]] at the [[Promenade]] shopping complex.<ref name="Red Light" /> However, Sadic was aware of the safe house's existence and dispatched [[Mark II Power Guard]]s to [[Raid on the SIS safe house|eliminate]] the SIS agents there; the Knight only arrived in [[Time/Legends|time]] to save some of the agents.<ref name="Striking Back" />

==Behind the scenes==
The fight in the cybernetics lab first appeared in the Jedi Knight-class mission "Red Light, Black Heart" on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Striking Back" />
